table_dq:
| Dataset | Check | What we found | How we handled it |
|---|---|---|---|
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Missing values | sales: 0 empty cells; discounts: 1 empty cell; customer purchases: 0 empty cells | The one empty discount is read as no discount (vis_forecast.py) |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Missing values | Google Trends: 0 empty cells in 96 search terms | A product gets no Google Trends feature if its term has under 8 weeks of data before release |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Duplicates | duplicate product-shop rows: sales 0, prices 0, restocks 0 | None found |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Duplicates | 1 identical customer purchase line (same customer, shop, product, second) | Kept: each line is a separate scan of the same item at the till |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Outliers | 3,386 negative weekly sales cells (0.3%): returns | Clipped to 0, since we model demand, not returns (vis_forecast.py) |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Outliers | discounts outside 0-100%: 0 | None found |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Outliers | 16 customer IDs buy in more than 10 shops (57,170 units, up to 69 shops) | Excluded: shop or generic cards, not real customers (vis_customers.py) |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Inconsistencies | 1.4% of purchase lines are for products not in the sales file; customers bought in 129 shops vs 110 in the sales file | Kept for frequency and spend; product-based measures (short-lived, markdown) use matched lines only |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Date alignment | 86,784 deliveries (686,883 units) arrive before the product's release date | Counted as opening stock in week 1 (vis_forecast.py) |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Scope filters | 62,711 units delivered after week 12 | Excluded: the analysis window is each product's first 12 weeks |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Scope filters | 24,651 purchase lines after February 2020 (the data holds only SS17-AW19 products; COVID closures follow) | Excluded from the customer analysis |
| VISUELLE 2.0 | Scope filters | 668 products sold fewer than 30 units in 12 weeks | Left out of lifecycle clustering only (unstable curve shape); 4,687 products clustered |
| Survey | Consent | 122 responses, 122 consented | Only consenting responses are analysed |
| Survey | Duplicates | 0 identical answer rows | None found |
| Survey | Missing values | Q9 (unplanned purchases) blank for 17 people | Q9 shares reported for those who answered |
| Survey | Inconsistencies | answer options edited mid-collection: 22 original + 100 edited responses | Both mapped to common bands; unmapped answers: 0 (survey_analysis.py) |
| Survey | Outliers | 1 respondent gave all 8 conjoint options the same rating | Excluded from the conjoint only (no preference information) |
| Survey | Privacy | 6 free-text comments | Never shown; no names or emails collected |

survey_status: Collected: 122 real responses (27 Sep 2026 to 10 Oct 2026), all with consent. Results are in section 5.9.
survey_conclusion: Our survey of 122 young consumers adds the other end of the chain: 36% wear a fast-fashion item 10 times or fewer, about 25% of the wardrobe went unworn last year, and lifespan was the most important feature when choosing a garment (31% of the decision).
